Key assessment findings for tension pneumothorax include hypotension (blood pressure 88/50 mmHg), absent breath sounds on the affected side (left lung field), tracheal deviation away from the affected side (trachea deviated to the right), and jugular venous distension (JVD) due to impaired venous return. These findings indicate a medical emergency requiring immediate intervention to decompress the chest.

These findings indicate a medical emergency requiring immediate intervention to decompress the chest.
